Amazon Essentials is focused on creating affordable, high-quality, and long-lasting everyday clothing you can rely on. Our line of women's apparel includes cashmere sweaters, fleece and down jackets, and more, including plus-size options. How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Amazon Customer
5 out of 5 stars
Good Quality & works with Hotfix stones
I purchased a set in navy and deep magenta for my adult daughter Shea, because I wanted to try to hotfix custom designs for her. I was reluctant because I thought it would melt. I started at a lower temp but 290 for 15 seconds on the front and back works well. I must add that the peel is a bit challenging because this soft fabric is nice and stretchy. The colors are deeper than the photos and more if a deep navy and plum. It could have been the lighting. I have a similar set in M (I’m 5’7” @ 135 lbs) which isn’t clingy but not snug. It fits just right. I originally purchased M for her but because of the fit, she needed XL for her 174 frame so that it’s not hugging her body.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Super buttery soft and stretchy!
    Reviewed in the United States on March 22, 2026
    Size: MediumColor: Charcoal Heather/Light Grey Heather
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    So buttery soft! I needed some new plain basic tees and found these were the best priced at only around $11 for two shirts. Reviews appeared to be good so I purchased two sets (four shirts). They came in the next day and I immediately noticed how buttery soft and stretchy they are! They are not see through at all. They are form fitting but not too tight. I’d say if you want a looser fit to size up. The only thing I don’t like is the shoulders have either too much fabric or it could just be because they are new and need a couple washes , but it makes the shoulders look pointed. I think that may go down once I wash and dry a couple times. I bought heather grey/ charcoal heather and navy/pink. The pink is more of a coral color so keep that in mind before purchasing that one. I am 5’1 and around 145lbs and I purchased these in Medium and they fit perfectly. All in all I do like these a lot and I’m glad I found some shirts that are not that moisture wick material which I do not care for. I will be purchasing a few more colors in these soon!

    5 out of 5 stars
    Update: white is see-through!! Great shirt, very slim fitting
    Reviewed in the United States on April 24, 2026
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I am 5’10”, 135 pounds and small chested.

    I wear a small in blouses and most t-shirts.

    I purchased a small. (I have attached photos of me in both the small (yellow shirt) and the medium)

    This shirt is a great length on me (I have a long torso), the material feels great, has stretch to it and comfortable.

    The mustard and olive colors I chose are as pictured and nice colors.

    It is definitely a slim fit, the material clings to the body.

    I love the shirt but will be returning for the medium because I want a bit more modest fit. Will be buying more in the next size up.

    *I was wearing a sports bra when I modeled the small yellow shirt, was wearing an underwire when I modeled the medium. You can see the outline of the underwire, guessing it would’ve been more apparent if I had wore it with the small shirt.

    UPDATE: just tried on the white (in medium), genuinely see-though. The fabric isn’t stretched our pulled tight on me, so no explanation except for tge shirt itself is inherently see-through. Would definitely not buy the white again.

    UPDATE: just tried on the white (in medium), genuinely see-though. The fabric isn’t stretched our pulled tight on me, so no explanation except for tge shirt itself is inherently see-through. Would definitely not buy the white again.
